fusions.name: Levelling Swing
fusions.desc: Brings a weighted chain down on an enemy for 32 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Ring
fusions.desc: Slams the chain down in a ring that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Deadweight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pressed Flat
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
